# kopia_repository_status (Data Source)

Reports whether the Kopia server has a repository connected, and how: the repository's format and algorithms, where it is stored, and the identity the server takes snapshots as. It works without a repository too, and then reports only `connected = false`, with every other attribute null.

Useful in a `check` block, to make sure the server is connected to the expected repository before anything else is applied. The throttle limits the server started with are left out, because Kopia reports them as they were at start-up; the `kopia_throttle` resource reads the limits in effect.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kopia_repository_status" "this" {}

output "repository_storage" {
  value = data.kopia_repository_status.this.storage # e.g. "filesystem"
}

# Make sure the server has the expected repository open before anything else
# relies on it.
check "kopia_repository_connected" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.kopia_repository_status.this.connected
    error_message = "The Kopia server has no repository connected."
  }

  assert {
    condition     = data.kopia_repository_status.this.config_file == "/app/config/repository.config"
    error_message = "The Kopia server keeps its config file somewhere other than the volume on /app/config."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `api_server_url` (String) Address of the Kopia repository server through which the server reaches its repository, or null when it is connected directly to the storage. With a repository server, the repository's format, algorithms and storage are not reported, and those attributes are null.
- `config_file` (String) Absolute path of the server's config file, `repository.config`, in which Kopia saves the repository description and the throttle limits: `/app/config/repository.config` for the official Docker image. Null for a repository reached through a Kopia repository server.
- `connected` (Boolean) Whether the server has a repository connected. Every other resource and data source except `kopia_current_user` and `kopia_algorithms` needs one.
- `description` (String) Description of the repository, as `kopia_repository_description` sets it; `Repository in <storage>` unless it was changed.
- `ecc` (String) Error-correction algorithm of the repository, such as `REED-SOLOMON-CRC32`, or null when error correction is off. It is null whenever `ecc_overhead_percent` is `0`, which is how Kopia itself decides that error correction is off: repositories created by old releases may name an algorithm they do not use.
- `ecc_overhead_percent` (Number) Share of the repository's storage spent on error correction, in percent; `0` when error correction is off. Null for a repository reached through a Kopia repository server.
- `enable_actions` (Boolean) Whether the server runs the actions — commands before and after snapshots — that policies define. Kopia ignores them unless the repository was connected with `--enable-actions`.
- `encryption` (String) Encryption algorithm of the repository, such as `AES256-GCM-HMAC-SHA256`.
- `format_blob_cache_duration` (String) How long the server caches the repository's format blob, as a Go duration such as `15m0s`, Kopia's default. A duration of zero or less, such as `-1ns` for a connection made with `--disable-repository-format-cache`, means it is not cached. Null when the server reports none.
- `format_version` (Number) Format version of the repository: `1`, `2` or `3`, which Kopia uses for new repositories.
- `hash` (String) Hash algorithm of the repository, such as `BLAKE2B-256-128`.
- `hostname` (String) Host name the server takes snapshots as. A source is local to the server, and snapshotted by it, when its host is this one. It is the repository connection's identity (`--override-hostname` of `kopia repository connect`), which need not match the host name of the machine that `kopia_current_user` reports.
- `max_pack_size` (Number) Largest size of a pack blob, in bytes: `20971520` (20 MiB) for new repositories.
- `readonly` (Boolean) Whether the repository is connected read-only, in which case the server takes no snapshots and treats every source as remote.
- `splitter` (String) Splitter the repository cuts files into chunks with, such as `DYNAMIC-4M-BUZHASH`.
- `storage` (String) Type of the repository's storage: `filesystem`, `s3`, `b2`, `gcs`, `azureBlob`, `sftp`, `webdav`, `rclone` or `gdrive`.
- `supports_content_compression` (Boolean) Whether the repository compresses data as it stores each content, which needs index version 2 or later. Without it, Kopia compresses file contents as whole objects instead.
- `username` (String) User name the server takes snapshots as: the repository connection's identity (`--override-username` of `kopia repository connect`), not the UI user the provider signs in as.
